serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Now that we ate, let’s go have some fun! How about some rides?
You: I don’t think that’s a good idea, unless you want me to throw up.
Bot: Would it be such a bad thing? You would get rid of the excess calories!
You: Think about other people a little, I wouldn’t want to hit anyone…
Bot: How kind of you.
You: Give me some time to rest and I will go on whatever ride you want. 
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
Bot: Great!
